cards.name: Air Elemental
cards.rules_text: Flying

cards.name: Ancestral Recall
cards.rules_text: Draw 3 cards or force opponent to draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Animate Artifact
cards.rules_text: Target artifact is now a creature with both power and toughness equal to its casting cost; target retains all its original abilities as well. This will destroy artifacts with 0 casting cost.

cards.name: Animate Dead
cards.rules_text: Any creature in either player's graveyard comes into play on your side with -1 to its original power. If this enchantment is removed, or at end of game, target creature is returned to its owner's graveyard. Target creature may be killed as normal.

cards.name: Animate Wall
cards.rules_text: Target wall can now attack. Target wall's power and toughness are unchanged, even if its power is 0.

cards.name: Ankh of Mishra
cards.rules_text: Ankh does 2 damage to anyone who puts a new land into play.

cards.name: Armageddon
cards.rules_text: All lands in play are destroyed.

cards.name: Aspect of Wolf
cards.rules_text: Target creature's power and toughness are increased by half the number of forests you have in play, rounding down for power and up for toughness.

cards.name: Badlands
cards.rules_text: Counts as both mountains and swamp and is affected by spells that affect either. Tap to add either {R} or {B} to your mana pool.

cards.name: Bad Moon
cards.rules_text: All black creatures in play gain +1/+1.

cards.name: Balance
cards.rules_text: Whichever player has more lands in play must discard enough lands of his or her choice to equalize the number of lands both players have in play. Cards in hand and creatures in play must be equalized the same way. Creatures lost in this manner may not be regenerated.

cards.name: Basalt Monolith
cards.rules_text: Tap to add 3 colorless mana to your mana pool. Does not untap as normal during untap phase; spend {3} to untap. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Bayou
cards.rules_text: Counts as both swamp and forest and is affected by spells that affect either. Tap to add either {B} or {G} to your mana pool.

cards.name: Benalish Hero
cards.rules_text: Bands

cards.name: Berserk
cards.rules_text: Until end of turn, target creature's current power doubles and it gains trample ability. If it attacks, target creature is destroyed at end of turn. This spell cannot be cast after current turn's attack is completed.

cards.name: Birds of Paradise
cards.rules_text:
Flying
Tap to add one mana of any color to your mana pool. This tap may be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Black Knight
cards.rules_text: Protection from white, first strike

cards.name: Black Lotus
cards.rules_text: Adds 3 mana of any single color of your choice to your mana pool, then is discarded. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Black Vise
cards.rules_text: If opponent has more than four cards in hand during upkeep, black vise does 1 damage to opponent for each card in excess of four.

cards.name: Black Ward
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains protection from black.

cards.name: Blaze of Glory
cards.rules_text: Target defending creature can and must block all attacking creatures it can legally block. For example, a normal non-flying target defender can and must block all normal non-flying attackers at once, but it cannot block any flying attackers. Controller of target defender may distribute damage among attackers as desired. Play before defense is chosen.

cards.name: Blessing
cards.rules_text: {W} Target creature gains +1/+1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Blue Elemental Blast
cards.rules_text: Counters a red spell being cast or destroys a red card in play.

cards.name: Blue Ward
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains protection from blue.

cards.name: Bog Wraith
cards.rules_text: Swampwalk

cards.name: Braingeyser
cards.rules_text: Draw X cards or force opponent to draw X cards.

cards.name: Burrowing
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains mountainwalk.

cards.name: Camouflage
cards.rules_text: You may rearrange your attacking creatures and place them face down, revealing which is which only after defense is chosen. If this results in impossible blocks, such as non-flying creatures blocking flying creatures, illegal blockers cannot block this turn.

cards.name: Castle
cards.rules_text: Your untapped creatures gain +0/+2. Attacking creatures lose this bonus.

cards.name: Celestial Prism
cards.rules_text: {2}: Provides 1 mana of any color. This use can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Channel
cards.rules_text: Until end of turn, you may add colorless mana to your mana pool, at a cost of 1 life each. These additions are played with the speed of an interrupt. Effects that prevent damage may not be used to counter this loss of life.

cards.name: Chaoslace
cards.rules_text: Changes the color of one card either being played or already in play to red. Cost to cast, tap, maintain, or use a special ability of target card remains entirely unchanged.

cards.name: Chaos Orb
cards.rules_text: {1}: Flip Chaos Orb onto the playing area from a height of at least one foot. Chaos Orb must turn completely over at least once or it is discarded with no effect. When Chaos Orb lands, any cards in play that it touches are destroyed, as is Chaos Orb.

cards.name: Circle of Protection: Black
cards.rules_text: {1}: Prevents all damage against you from one black source. If a source does damage to you more than once in a turn, you must pay 1 mana each time to prevent the damage.

cards.name: Circle of Protection: Blue
cards.rules_text: {1}: Prevents all damage against you from one blue source. If a source does damage to you more than once in a turn, you must pay 1 mana each time to prevent the damage.

cards.name: Circle of Protection: Green
cards.rules_text: {1}: Prevents all damage against you from one green source. If a source does damage to you more than once in a turn, you must pay 1 mana each time to prevent the damage.

cards.name: Circle of Protection: Red
cards.rules_text: {1}: Prevents all damage against you from one red source. If a source does damage to you more than once in a turn, you must pay 1 mana each time to prevent the damage.

cards.name: Circle of Protection: White
cards.rules_text: {1}: Prevents all damage against you from one white source. If a source does damage to you more than once in a turn, you must pay 1 mana each time to prevent the damage.

cards.name: Clockwork Beast
cards.rules_text: Put seven +1/+0 counters on Beast. After Beast attacks or blocks a creature, discard a counter. During the untap phase, controller may buy back lost counters for 1 mana per counter instead of tapping Beast; this taps Beast if it wasn't tapped already.

cards.name: Clone
cards.rules_text: Upon summoning, Clone acquires all characteristics, including color, of any one creature in play on either side; any creature enchantments on original creature are not copied. Clone retains these characteristics even after original creature is destroyed. Clone cannot be played if there are no creatures in play.

cards.name: Cockatrice
cards.rules_text:
Flying
Any non-wall creature blocking Cockatrice is destroyed, as is any creature blocked by Cockatrice. Creatures destroyed in this way deal their damage before dying.

cards.name: Consecrate Land
cards.rules_text: All enchantments on target land are destroyed. Land cannot be destroyed or further enchanted until Consecrate Land has been destroyed.

cards.name: Conservator
cards.rules_text: {3}: Prevent the loss of up to 2 life.

cards.name: Contract from Below
cards.rules_text: Discard your current hand and draw eight new cards, adding the first drawn to your ante. Remove this card from your deck before playing if you are not playing for ante.

cards.name: Control Magic
cards.rules_text: You control target creature until enchantment is discarded or game ends. You can't tap target creature this turn, but if it was already tapped it stays tapped until you can untap it. If destroyed, target creature is put in its owner's graveyard.

cards.name: Conversion
cards.rules_text: All mountains are considered plains while Conversion is in play. Pay {W}{W} during upkeep or Conversion is discarded.

cards.name: Copper Tablet
cards.rules_text: Copper Tablet does 1 damage to each player during his or her upkeep.

cards.name: Copy Artifact
cards.rules_text: Select any artifact in play. This enchantment acts as a duplicate of that artifact; enchantment copy is affected by cards that affect either enchantments or artifacts. Enchantment copy remains even if original artifact is destroyed.

cards.name: Counterspell
cards.rules_text: Counters target spell as it is being cast.

cards.name: Creature Bond
cards.rules_text: If target creature is destroyed, Creature Bond does an amount of damage equal to creature's toughness to creature's controller.

cards.name: Crusade
cards.rules_text: All white creatures gain +1/+1.

cards.name: Crystal Rod
cards.rules_text: {1}: Any blue spell cast by any player gives you 1 life.

cards.name: Cursed Land
cards.rules_text: Cursed Land does 1 damage to target land's controller during each upkeep.

cards.name: Cyclopean Tomb
cards.rules_text: {2}: Turn any one non-swamp land into swamp during upkeep. Mark the changed lands with tokens. If Cyclopean Tomb is destroyed, remove one token of your choice each upkeep, returning that land to its original nature.

cards.name: Darkpact
cards.rules_text: Without looking at it first, swap top card of your library with either card of the ante; this swap is permanent. You must have a card in your library to cast this spell. Remove this card from your deck before playing if you are not playing for ante.

cards.name: Dark Ritual
cards.rules_text: Add 3 black mana to your mana pool.

cards.name: Deathgrip
cards.rules_text: {B}{B} Destroy a green spell as it is being cast. This action may be played as an interrupt, and does not affect green cards already in play.

cards.name: Deathlace
cards.rules_text: Changes the color of one card either being played or already in play to black. Cost to cast, tap, maintain, or use a special ability of target card remains entirely unchanged.

cards.name: Death Ward
cards.rules_text: Regenerates target creature.

cards.name: Demonic Attorney
cards.rules_text: If opponent doesn't concede the game immediately, each player must ante an additional card from the top of his or her library. Remove this card from your deck before playing if you are not playing for ante.

cards.name: Demonic Hordes
cards.rules_text: Tap to destroy 1 land. Pay {B}{B}{B} during upkeep or the Hordes become tapped and you lose a land of opponent's choice.

cards.name: Demonic Tutor
cards.rules_text: You may search your library for one card and take it into your hand. Reshuffle your library afterwards.

cards.name: Dingus Egg
cards.rules_text: Whenever anyone loses a land, Egg does 2 damage to that player for each land lost.

cards.name: Disenchant
cards.rules_text: Target enchantment or artifact must be discarded.

cards.name: Disintegrate
cards.rules_text: Disintegrate does X damage to one target. If target dies this turn, it is removed from game entirely and cannot be regenerated. Return target to its owner's deck only when game is over.

cards.name: Disrupting Scepter
cards.rules_text: {3}: Opponent must discard one card of his or her choice. Can only be used during your turn.

cards.name: Dragon Whelp
cards.rules_text:
Flying
{R} +1/+0 until end of turn; if more than {R}{R}{R} is spent in this way, Dragon Whelp is destroyed at end of turn.

cards.name: Drain Life
cards.rules_text: Drain Life does 1 damage to a single target for each {B} spent in addition to the casting cost. Caster gains 1 life for each damage inflicted. If you drain life from a creature, you cannot gain more life than the creature's toughness.

cards.name: Drain Power
cards.rules_text: Tap all opponent's land, taking all this mana and all mana in opponent's mana pool into your mana pool. You can't tap fewer than all opponent's lands.

cards.name: Drudge Skeletons
cards.rules_text: {B} Regenerates

cards.name: Dwarven Demolition Team
cards.rules_text: Tap to destroy a wall.

cards.name: Dwarven Warriors
cards.rules_text: Tap to make a creature of power no greater than 2 unblockable until end of turn. Other cards may later be used to increase target creature's power beyond 2 after defense is chosen.

cards.name: Earthbind
cards.rules_text: Earthbind does 2 damage to target flying creature, which also loses flying ability.

cards.name: Earthquake
cards.rules_text: Does X damage to each player and each non-flying creature in play.

cards.name: Elvish Archers
cards.rules_text: First strike

cards.name: Evil Presence
cards.rules_text: Target land is now a swamp.

cards.name: False Orders
cards.rules_text: You decide whether and how one defending creature blocks, though you can't make a choice the defender couldn't legally make. Play after defender has chosen defense but before damage is dealt.

cards.name: Farmstead
cards.rules_text: Target land's controller gains 1 life each upkeep if {W}{W} is spent. Target land still generates mana as usual.

cards.name: Fastbond
cards.rules_text: You may put as many lands into play as you want each turn. Fastbond does 1 damage to you for every land beyond the first that you play in a single turn.

cards.name: Fear
cards.rules_text: Target creature cannot be blocked by any creatures other than artifact creatures and black creatures.

cards.name: Feedback
cards.rules_text: Feedback does 1 damage to controller of target enchantment during each upkeep.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.rules_text: Fireball does X damage total, divided evenly (round down) among any number of targets. Pay 1 extra mana for each target beyond the first.

cards.name: Flashfires
cards.rules_text: All plains in play are destroyed.

cards.name: Flight
cards.rules_text: Target creature is now a flying creature.

cards.name: Fog
cards.rules_text: Creatures attack and block as normal, but none deal any damage. All attacking creatures are still tapped. Play any time before attack damage is dealt.

cards.name: Forcefield
cards.rules_text: {1}: Lose only 1 life to an unblocked creature.

cards.name: Force of Nature
cards.rules_text:
Trample
You must pay {G}{G}{G}{G} during upkeep or Force of Nature does 8 damage to you. You may still attack with Force of Nature even if you failed to pay the upkeep.

cards.name: Forest
cards.rules_text: Tap to add {G} to your mana pool.

cards.name: Fork
cards.rules_text: Any sorcery or instant spell just cast is doubled. Treat Fork as an exact copy of target spell except that Fork remains red. Copy and original may have different targets.

cards.name: Fungusaur
cards.rules_text: Each time Fungusaur is damaged but not destroyed, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Gaea's Liege
cards.rules_text: When defending, Gaea's Liege has power and toughness equal to the number of forests you have in play; when it's attacking, they are equal to the number of forests opponent has in play. Tap to turn any one land into a forest until Gaea's Liege leaves play. Mark changed lands with counters, removing the counters when Gaea's Liege leaves play.

cards.name: Gauntlet of Might
cards.rules_text: All red creatures gain +1/+1 and all mountains provide an extra red mana when tapped.

cards.name: Giant Growth
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains +3/+3 until end of turn.

cards.name: Giant Spider
cards.rules_text: Does not fly, but can block flying creatures.

cards.name: Glasses of Urza
cards.rules_text: You may look at opponent's hand.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.rules_text: White spells cost 3 more mana to cast. Circles of Protection cost 3 more mana to use.

cards.name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
cards.rules_text: {R} Goblins gain flying ability until end of turn. Controller may not choose to make Goblins fly after they have been blocked.

cards.name: Goblin King
cards.rules_text: Goblins in play gain mountainwalk and +1/+1 while this card remains in play.

cards.name: Granite Gargoyle
cards.rules_text: Flying; {R} +0/+1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Green Ward
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains protection from green.

cards.name: Guardian Angel
cards.rules_text: Prevents X damage from being dealt to any one target. Any further damage to the same target this turn can be canceled by spending 1 mana per point of damage to be canceled.

cards.name: Healing Salve
cards.rules_text: Gain 3 life, or prevent up to 3 damage from being dealt to a single target.

cards.name: Helm of Chatzuk
cards.rules_text: {1}: You may give one creature the ability to band until end of turn.

cards.name: Holy Armor
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains +0/+2. {W} Target creature gets extra +0/+1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Holy Strength
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains +1/+2.

cards.name: Howl from Beyond
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains +X/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Howling Mine
cards.rules_text: Each player draws one extra card each turn during his or her draw phase.

cards.name: Hurricane
cards.rules_text: All players and flying creatures suffer X damage.

cards.name: Hypnotic Specter
cards.rules_text:
Flying
An opponent damaged by Specter must discard a card at random from his or her hand. Ignore this effect if opponent has no cards left in hand.

cards.name: Ice Storm
cards.rules_text: Destroys any one land.

cards.name: Icy Manipulator
cards.rules_text: {1}: You may tap any land, creature, or artifact in play on either side. No effects are generated by the target card.

cards.name: Illusionary Mask
cards.rules_text: {X} You can summon a creature face down so opponent doesn't know what it is. The X cost can be any amount of mana, even 0; it serves to hide the true casting cost of the creature, which you still have to spend. As soon as a face-down creature receives damage, deals damage, or is tapped, you must turn it face up.

cards.name: Instill Energy
cards.rules_text: You may untap target creature both during your untap phase and one additional time during your turn. Target creature may attack the turn it comes into play.

cards.name: Invisibility
cards.rules_text: Target creature can be blocked only by walls.

cards.name: Ironclaw Orcs
cards.rules_text: Cannot be used to block any creature of power more than 1.

cards.name: Iron Star
cards.rules_text: {1}: Any red spell cast by any player gives you 1 life.

cards.name: Island
cards.rules_text: Tap to add {U} to your mana pool.

cards.name: Island Sanctuary
cards.rules_text: You may decline to draw a card from your library during draw phase. In exchange, until start of your next turn the only creatures that may attack you are those that fly or have islandwalk.

cards.name: Ivory Cup
cards.rules_text: {1}: Any white spell cast by any player gives you 1 life.

cards.name: Jade Monolith
cards.rules_text: {1}: You may take damage done to any creature on yourself instead, but you must take all of it. Source of damage is unchanged.

cards.name: Jade Statue
cards.rules_text: {2}: Jade Statue becomes a creature for the duration of the current attack exchange. Can be a creature only during an attack or defense.

cards.name: Jayemdae Tome
cards.rules_text: {4}: You may draw one extra card.

cards.name: Juggernaut
cards.rules_text: Must attack each turn if possible. Can't be blocked by walls.

cards.name: Jump
cards.rules_text: Target creature is a flying creature until end of turn.

cards.name: Karma
cards.rules_text: For each swamp in play, Karma does 1 damage to the swamp owner during the swamp owner's upkeep.

cards.name: Keldon Warlord
cards.rules_text: The Xs below are the number of non-wall creatures on your side, including Warlord. Thus if you have 2 other non-wall creatures, Warlord is 3/3. If one of those creatures is killed during the turn, Warlord immediately becomes 2/2.

cards.name: Kormus Bell
cards.rules_text: Treat all swamps in play as 1/1 creatures. Now they can be enchanted, killed, and so forth, and they can be tapped either for mana or to attack. Swamps have no color; they are not considered black cards.

cards.name: Kudzu
cards.rules_text: When target land becomes tapped, it is destroyed. Unless that was the last land in play, Kudzu is not discarded; instead, the player whose land it just destroyed may place it on another land of his or her choice.

cards.name: Lance
cards.rules_text: Target creature gains first strike.

cards.name: Ley Druid
cards.rules_text: Tap Druid to untap a land of your choice. This action can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Library of Leng
cards.rules_text: There is no limit to size of your hand. If a card forces you to discard, you may choose to discard to top of your library rather than to graveyard. If discard is random, you may look at card before deciding where to discard it.

cards.name: Lich
cards.rules_text: You lose all life. If you gain life later in the game, instead draw one card from your library for each life. For each point of damage you suffer, you must destroy one of your cards in play. Creatures destroyed in this way cannot be regenerated. You lose if this enchantment is destroyed or if you suffer a point of damage without sending a card to the graveyard.

cards.name: Lifeforce
cards.rules_text: {G}{G}: Destroy a black spell as it is being cast. This use may be played as an interrupt, and does not affect black cards already in play.

cards.name: Lifelace
cards.rules_text: Changes the color of one card either being played or already in play to green. Cost to cast, tap, maintain, or use a special ability of target card remains entirely unchanged.

cards.name: Lifetap
cards.rules_text: You gain 1 life each time any forest of opponent's becomes tapped.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt
cards.rules_text: Lightning Bolt does 3 damage to one target.

cards.name: Living Artifact
cards.rules_text: Put a counter on target artifact for each life you lose. During upkeep you may trade one counter for one life, but you can only trade in one counter each turn.

cards.name: Living Lands
cards.rules_text: Treat all forests in play as 1/1 creatures. Now they can be enchanted, killed, and so forth, and they can be tapped either for mana or to attack. The living lands have no color; they are not considered green cards.

cards.name: Living Wall
cards.rules_text: Counts as a wall. {1}: Regenerates.

cards.name: Llanowar Elves
cards.rules_text: Tap to add 1 green mana to your mana pool. This tap can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Lord of Atlantis
cards.rules_text: All Merfolk in play gain islandwalk and +1/+1 while this card is in play.

cards.name: Lord of the Pit
cards.rules_text:
Flying, trample
You must sacrifice one of your own creatures during upkeep or Lord of the Pit does 7 damage to you. You may still attack with Lord of the Pit even if you failed to sacrifice a creature.

cards.name: Lure
cards.rules_text: All creatures able to block target creature must do so. If a creature has the ability to block more than one creature, Lure does not prevent this. If there is more than one attacking creature with Lure, defender may choose which of them each defending creature blocks.

cards.name: Magical Hack
cards.rules_text: Change the text of any card being played or already in play by replacing one basic land type with another. For example, you can change "swampwalk" to "plainswalk."

cards.name: Mahamoti Djinn
cards.rules_text: Flying

cards.name: Manabarbs
cards.rules_text: Whenever any land is tapped, Manabarbs does 1 damage to the land's controller.

cards.name: Mana Flare
cards.rules_text: Whenever either player taps land for mana, each land produces 1 extra mana of the appropriate type.

cards.name: Mana Short
cards.rules_text: All opponent's lands are tapped, and opponent's mana pool is emptied. Opponent takes no damage from unspent mana.

cards.name: Mana Vault
cards.rules_text: Tap to add 3 colorless mana to your mana pool. Mana Vault doesn't untap normally during untap phase; to untap it, you must pay 4 mana. If Mana Vault remains tapped during upkeep it does 1 damage to you. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Meekstone
cards.rules_text: Any creature with power greater than 2 may not be untapped as normal during the untap phase.

cards.name: Mesa Pegasus
cards.rules_text: Flying, bands

cards.name: Mind Twist
cards.rules_text: Opponent must discard X cards at random from hand. If opponent doesn't have enough cards in hand, entire hand is discarded.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.rules_text: Tap to add {R} to your mana pool.

cards.name: Mox Emerald
cards.rules_text: Add 1 green mana to your mana pool. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Mox Jet
cards.rules_text: Add 1 black mana to your mana pool. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Mox Pearl
cards.rules_text: Add 1 white mana to your mana pool. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Mox Ruby
cards.rules_text: Add 1 red mana to your mana pool. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Mox Sapphire
cards.rules_text: Add 1 blue mana to your mana pool. Tapping this artifact can be played as an interrupt.

cards.name: Natural Selection
cards.rules_text: Look at top three cards of any player's library. You may opt to rearrange those three cards or shuffle the entire library.

cards.name: Nether Shadow
cards.rules_text: If Shadow is in graveyard with any combination of cards above it that includes at least three creatures, it can be returned to play during upkeep for its normal casting cost. Shadow can attack on same turn summoned or returned to play.

cards.name: Nettling Imp
cards.rules_text: Tap to force a particular one of opponent's non-wall creatures to attack. If target creature cannot attack, it is destroyed at end of turn. This tap should be played during opponent's turn, before the attack. May not be used on creatures summoned this turn.

cards.name: Nevinyrral's Disk
cards.rules_text: {1}: Destroys all creatures, enchantments, and artifacts in play. Disk begins tapped but can be untapped as usual. Disk destroys itself when used.

cards.name: Nightmare
cards.rules_text:
Flying
Nightmare's power and toughness both equal the number of swamps its controller has in play.

cards.name: Northern Paladin
cards.rules_text: {W}{W} and tap: Destroys a black card in play. Cannot be used to cancel a black spell as it is being cast.

cards.name: Orcish Artillery
cards.rules_text: Tap to do 2 damage to any target, but you suffer 3 damage as well.

cards.name: Orcish Oriflamme
cards.rules_text: When attacking, all of your attacking creatures gain +1/+0.

cards.name: Paralyze
cards.rules_text: Target creature is not untapped as normal during untap phase unless 4 mana are spent. Tap target creature when Paralyze is cast.

cards.name: Personal Incarnation
cards.rules_text: Caster can redirect any or all damage done to Personal Incarnation to self instead. The source of the damage is unchanged. If Personal Incarnation is destroyed, caster loses half his or her remaining life points, rounding up the loss.

cards.name: Pestilence
cards.rules_text: {B}: Do 1 damage to each creature and to both players. Pestilence must be discarded at end of any turn in which there are no creatures in play at end of turn.

cards.name: Phantasmal Forces
cards.rules_text:
Flying
Controller must spend {U} during upkeep to maintain or Phantasmal Forces are destroyed.

cards.name: Phantasmal Terrain
cards.rules_text: Target land changes to any basic land type of caster's choice. Land type is set when cast and may not be further altered by this enchantment.

cards.name: Phantom Monster
cards.rules_text: Flying

cards.name: Pirate Ship
cards.rules_text: Tap to do 1 damage to any target. Cannot attack unless opponent has islands in play, though controller may still tap. Pirate Ship is destroyed immediately if at any time controller has no islands in play.

cards.name: Plague Rats
cards.rules_text: The Xs below are the number of Plague Rats in play, counting both sides. Thus if there are 2 Plague Rats in play, each has power and toughness 2/2.

cards.name: Plains
cards.rules_text: Tap to add {W} to your mana pool.

cards.name: Plateau
cards.rules_text: Counts as both mountains and plains and is affected by spells that affect either. Tap to add either {R} or {W} to your mana pool.

cards.name: Power Leak
cards.rules_text: Target enchantment costs 2 extra mana during upkeep. If target enchantment's controller cannot or will not pay this extra mana, Power Leak does 1 damage to him or her for each unpaid mana.

cards.name: Power Sink
cards.rules_text: Target spell is countered unless its caster spends X more mana; caster of target spell can't choose to let it be countered. If caster of target spell doesn't have enough mana, all available mana from lands and mana pool must be paid but target spell will still be countered.

cards.name: Power Surge
cards.rules_text: Before untapping lands at the start of a turn, each player takes 1 damage for each land he or she controls but did not tap during the previous turn.

cards.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
cards.rules_text: Tap to do 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Psionic Blast
cards.rules_text: Psionic Blast does 4 damage to any target, but it does 2 damage to you as well.

cards.name: Psychic Venom
cards.rules_text: Whenever target land is tapped, Psychic Venom does 2 damage to target land's controller.

cards.name: Purelace
